# CLI Proxy API: Architectural Specification & Reference

## 1. Overview & Request Pipeline
CLI Proxy API is a high-concurrency Go 1.26+ API gateway bridging coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, Aider) and heterogeneous LLM providers.

```text
Client Agents (Anthropic / OpenAI / Codex WS / Gemini wire)
  -> Gateway Layer (Auth, Body Decompression, SelectiveGzip, SSE Keepalive, LoopGuard)
  -> Routing & Affinity (SessionCache [session_affinity.json], 429 Sink Pool, 5 Selectors)
  -> Protocol & Thinking Pipeline (ApplyThinking -> Canonical ThinkingConfig -> Payload Rules)
  -> Runtime Executors (Claude, Codex, Gemini/Antigravity, WorkBuddy, OpenCode, Kimi, Grok, Muse, Devin)
```

## 2. Thinking & Payload Invariance
- **Canonical Thinking (`internal/thinking/`)**: `suffix.go` parses model suffixes (overrides body) -> `types.go` normalizes to `ThinkingConfig` -> `validate.go`/`convert.go` -> `ProviderApplier` emits provider wire format (including Claude preserved-thinking `drop_block` and `between_tools`).
- **Payload Semantic Barrier**: Built-in translation, normalization, and cleanup run first; user payload override/filter rules execute once as the final semantic step. Only transport framing (e.g. WorkBuddy `stream: true`) and serialization follow.

## 3. Scheduling & Session Affinity (`sdk/cliproxy/auth/`)
- **Strategies (`routing.strategy`)**:
  - `round-robin` / `weighted-round-robin` / `fill-first`
  - `smart`: Segments accounts into `fine` (<80%), `low` (80–98%), and `spent` (>=98%) tiers, prioritizing earliest reset windows (hour-truncated for cache stability).
  - `pace`: Ranks by hourly burn headroom ($\text{Remaining} / \max(1, \text{Hours until reset})$) within a 10% tolerance band.
- **429 Sink Pool (`sink.go`)**: Demotes rate-limited credentials to the tail of selection queues with exponential cooldowns.
- **Persistent Session Affinity (`session_cache_store.go`)**: Binds session hashes (`session_id`, `X-Magpie-Session`, `X-OpenCode-Session`, `X-Cursor-Session-Id`, or first-user-turn anchor) to credentials across restarts (`session_affinity.json`) with sliding-window TTL.

## 4. Tencent WorkBuddy / CodeBuddy Suite (`internal/auth/workbuddy/`, `workbuddy_executor.go`)
- **Dual-Realm & Overseas Egress**: `workbuddy-cn` (`copilot.tencent.com`, overridable via `WB_CN_CHAT_UPSTREAM=https://www.workbuddy.cn` to avoid overseas TLS RST) and `workbuddy` (`workbuddy.ai`).
- **5.8.4 Cloaking & WAF Compliance**: Injects `X-Conversation-ID`, `X-Conversation-Request-ID`, `X-Root-Request-ID`, `X-Conversation-Message-ID`, W3C/B3 trace headers, and default system prompt (`11128` guard); strips `X-Machine-ID`/`X-Session-ID`.
- **Stream Enforcement**: Enforces `"stream": true` upstream and folds non-streaming calls via `AggregateWorkBuddyStream` (bypassing `11101`).
- **Credits & Check-in**: Live multipliers from `GET /v3/config` (`models.variant-mode: compact|raw|all`), package expiry tracking, CST `CheckinEngine` (`workbuddy_checkins.json`), and outage compensation claiming (`POST /billing/meter/claim-compensation`).

## 5. OpenCode Zen Protocol (`opencode_cloaking.go`, `opencode_models.go`)
- Rewrites `/zen/v1` to `/inference/v1`, self-heals `oc_sk_...` tokens, injects `opencode/1.19.0` headers and valid `bash`/`read` tool schemas, and strips stub tool calls in streaming/non-streaming responses.

## 6. Stream Resilience & Zero-Knowledge Redaction (`sdk/cliproxy/redact/`)
- **SSE Keep-Alive & LoopGuard**: Emits 15s `: keep-alive` comments during slow reasoning and aborts repetitive 256-window thinking loops (`stream_loop_detected`).
- **Zero-Knowledge Redaction**: Masks secrets/PII into deterministic HMAC-SHA256 placeholders (`{{API_KEY_...}}`) before upstream dispatch and restores them across streaming chunk boundaries.

## 7. Endpoints Summary
- **Inference**: `POST /v1/chat/completions`, `POST /v1/messages`, `POST|GET /v1/responses` (HTTP & WS), `GET /v1/models`, `POST /v1/embeddings`, `POST /v1/videos`.
- **Management (`/v8/management`)**: `/config`, `/credentials`, `/oauth/auth-url`, `/workbuddy/checkin`, `/workbuddy/compensation`, `/plugins/workbuddy/quota`, `/models/global-excluded-models`, `/models/exit-catalog`, `/routing/cooldown/reset`, `/observability/logs`.

## 8. FAQ & Common Troubleshooting Matrix

| Symptom / Error Code | Root Cause | Resolution |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| WorkBuddy `11101` (`Get empty response`) | Upstream rejects `"stream": false` | Handled automatically by `workbuddy_executor.go` (`stream: true` + `AggregateWorkBuddyStream`) |
| WorkBuddy `11128` (`channel error`) | Missing 5.8.4 headers or system role | Handled by `ApplyWorkBuddyCloaking` and `EnsureWorkBuddySystemPrompt` |
| Overseas CN WorkBuddy `EOF` / TLS Reset | Cross-border SNI reset on `copilot.tencent.com` | Set `WB_CN_CHAT_UPSTREAM=https://www.workbuddy.cn` in `.env` |
| HTTP 400 `model_multiplier_mismatch` | Client suffix differs from live `/v3/config` rate | Refresh `/v1/models` or omit `:Nx` suffix to route by bare model alias |
| Cloudflare / Nginx HTTP 524 / 504 | Idle SSE connection during deep reasoning | Enabled by default via 15s `: keep-alive` heartbeat frames |
